justifiedBaselineUpdates.reason: PR #4 (provider-independent AI with Anthropic/OpenAI failover) Codex review finding #3: runWardrobeAgent.js previously defaulted `modelName` to a hardcoded Claude model string and always forwarded it as `params.model`, which permanently shadowed the chat client's own configured model — making ANTHROPIC_MODEL/OPENAI_MODEL env vars silently ineffective for Wardrobe AI. Fix: `modelName` now has no default (left undefined when the caller omits it), so the chat client's own configured default applies; an explicit `modelName` still overrides it, same precedence as before. The tool-calling loop itself, the eight deterministic tools it drives, and every other line of behavior are unchanged — verified via `git diff` and the full existing runWardrobeAgent test suite plus new regression tests in src/lib/ai-provider/anthropicChatClient.test.js.
justifiedBaselineUpdates.diffSummary: Removed the DEFAULT_MODEL_NAME constant and its use as the `modelName` parameter default; updated doc comments to explain the new model-resolution precedence. No change to the tool-calling loop, message construction, or tool execution.
